comparison.objective: Install two gondola shelf brackets at a marked level and seat a shelf; candidate installs one DGX rack rail across front and rear posts.
comparison.physical_skill: Hook two independent brackets into upright slots and place a shelf across them versus orient and bimanually support a handed telescoping rail, depress a tab, insert spring prongs at two depths, and screw it down.
comparison.success_condition: Requires both brackets seated at level 3 and a stable, level shelf; candidate requires correct side/orientation, front and rear prong pairs at one rack unit, full spring extension, bottom-hole screws, and self-support.
comparison.reason: This is the closest record because both install load-bearing rack hardware at a common level. The candidate nevertheless tests a meaningfully different staged ability: retaining one end while telescoping and latching the other, followed by prescribed screw fastening. Candidate force and overload thresholds remain unspecified.
